description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Somewhere in the last twenty years you stopped having to finish the sentence.

Every enemy who can see or hear you and who is of a lower level than you must succeed at a Will save against your Class DC or become frightened 3 and fleeing for 1 round; on a critical failure it surrenders outright if surrendering is something it is capable of. Creatures who have never heard of you take this save with a +2 circumstance bonus, and there are fewer of them every year.
